operative_bound_note: The operative Stage-1 execution price bound is the US-geo conservative basis 3.30 / 16.50 per MTok. The prior 3.00 / 15.00 (global) basis is NOT the operative bound; it is retained only as historical predecessor evidence (item6_stage1_price_table_v1).
reason: The frozen inference profile is the US geographic profile us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6. The prior table used global Sonnet 4.6 rates (3.00 / 15.00). For the frozen US geographic inference profile the conservative US-only Sonnet 4.6 standard-rate basis 3.30 / 16.50 per MTok is used. This is a spend-control accounting correction only; the model/profile is unchanged and no scientific treatment changes.
provenance_note: These are the conservative US-only Sonnet 4.6 standard-rate execution price bounds adopted as the frozen Item 6 Stage-1 spend-control assumption for the US geographic inference profile. If AWS list pricing differs at authorization time the human authorizer must re-freeze this table before execution.
reservation_uses_upper_margin: Reservation uses these frozen prices at multiplier 1.0 against the authoritative provider CountTokens input-token count (with the frozen MAX_REQUEST_UTF8_BYTES byte ceiling retained as an independent constraint) and the frozen MAX_TOKENS output bound; the conservatism lives in the token bounds and the US-only price basis, not a price inflation factor.

worst_case_reservation_reference.note: MAX_INPUT_RESERVE_PER_CALL = 32768 * 3.30 / 1e6; MAX_OUTPUT_RESERVE_PER_CALL = 8192 * 16.50 / 1e6. This byte-ceiling-derived per-call figure is the absolute worst case; the runner reserves the authoritative provider CountTokens input count per call, which is <= this byte-ceiling bound.
